1.explanation: We render two ComboBox instances side by side. Both use initialSelectedItem to display the ListBox.Selection pill (the “X” clear-selection badge). The first ComboBox also has invalid=true and invalidText set, which triggers the invalid state styling path in ComboBox.js. Because the ComboBox component reuses the generic ListBox.Selection component (which shares CSS with the MultiSelect), the little pill is picking up multiselect styles (dark background / large padding) instead of the combo-box styles, and the invalid warning icon ends up inside the input field rather than next to it in the wrapper. This minimal demo reproduces exactly the visual bug shown in the screenshots.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a controlled Carbon ComboBox with a selected item (so that the clear-selection “X” pill is shown) and you also mark the ComboBox as invalid (invalid=true with invalidText), the little “X” pill uses the multiselect selection styling rather than the combo-box styling. In our screenshots, the clear pill is black (multiselect style) next to the invalid red border, and the invalid warning icon is mis-positioned inside the input field.
